description.value: Green Leaf Vietnamese Bistro is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant operating three locations in British Columbia, with its original Victoria outpost on Douglas Street. The menu spans classic pho noodle soups, fresh salad rolls, vermicelli bowls, and rice plates crafted from fresh, premium ingredients in the tradition of Vietnamese culinary heritage. Cyclists stopping in can choose between a full sit-down dining experience with reservations or convenient online ordering for takeout.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 93m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at greenleafvic.ca is live and confirms the OSM name and Douglas Street Victoria address. Online ordering is explicitly offered ('relish our culinary creations from the comfort of your own space'), confirming takeout. The menu page notes 'Gluten-Friendly and Veggie Option Available' for spring rolls, and multiple tofu and vegetable dishes appear throughout the menu, confirming vegetarian/GF options. No mention of bike infrastructure, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
